label: Open Design
description: Synthetic integration-test fixture; not an installed capability.

fallback.warning: Use only when od is verified as the Open Design CLI and the daemon is actually on port 7456.

discovery: Windows loopback listener discovery by Get-NetTCPConnection or netstat

install_notes: Open Design App or daemon must be installed and running on the current machine.
Packaged desktop mode can use dynamic loopback ports and sidecar IPC; prefer /api/mcp/install-info.
Do not assume /usr/bin/od is Open Design.
For Codex, verify with codex mcp list after installation.
